## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes (lint, typecheck, tests)
- [ ] Docs updated (README / docs/) for any behavior, configuration or error-code change
- [ ] Security-relevant change? Updated docs/threat-model.md and the matching `test/security/*` test (invariant IDs)
- [ ] New migration? Additive only (docs/operations/upgrades.md) and listed in CHANGELOG.md "Upgrade notes"
- [ ] Design change? Added or updated an ADR in docs/adr/
